lines.text: You waited for light. Then you drove.
Three weeks without food. Three days without water.
lines.cap:
THREE WEEKS WITHOUT FOOD.
THREE DAYS WITHOUT WATER.

lines.text: Day three. And the water is going to cost you the exit.
lines.cap:
DAY 3. THE WATER WILL
COST YOU THE EXIT.

lines.text: A service station, two A M. Every shelf is already empty.
lines.cap:
A SERVICE STATION, 2 AM.
EVERY SHELF ALREADY EMPTY.

lines.text: Rule one. Nobody loots the plumbing.
So you don't look at shelves. You look for pipes.
Forty litres in the water heater. Cold, because grid seven died on day one.
Rule two. Never let a door close between you and your car.
lines.cap:
RULE 2. NEVER LET A DOOR
CLOSE BEHIND YOU.

lines.text: You wedge it open with a crate. The car is sixty feet away.
lines.cap:
YOU WEDGE IT WITH A CRATE.
THE CAR IS SIXTY FEET AWAY.

lines.text: Radio. Recovery in eight days. Avoid enclosed retail.
Rule three. If the lights come on, leave.
Thirty-one litres and a paper map. Eleven minutes.
lines.cap:
31 LITRES AND A PAPER MAP.
ELEVEN MINUTES.

lines.text: Bad news. One exit. And you're at the back of it.
lines.cap:
BAD NEWS. ONE EXIT.
YOU'RE AT THE BACK OF IT.

lines.text: Two oh six. Every light in the building comes on at once.
lines.cap:
2:06 AM. EVERY LIGHT
COMES ON AT ONCE.

lines.text: Then a voice over the P A. Calm. Bored.
lines.cap:
THEN A VOICE OVER THE PA.
CALM. BORED.

lines.text: Store's reopening. Bring what you've got to the front, and we'll check you out.
Grid seven died on day one. Nothing in this building has power.
lines.cap:
GRID 7 DIED ON DAY ONE.
NOTHING HERE HAS POWER.

lines.text: Do you walk to the front?
